notes: Catch-all 'other property' period (12 Del. C. 1133(17)). Report covers the 12 months before Jan 1 (1144(a)). Notice not more than 120 nor less than 60 days before filing (1148).
5 years after owner's last indication of interest (1133(18)). Holder liquidates within 90 days before filing and remits proceeds (1152(f)).
Business corporation credit balances, APL 1315. First-class notice at least 90 days before the final report; certified mail at least 60 days before for owners over $1,000.
APL 1319. June 30 cut-off, report and deliver by Nov 10. OSC says to contact NYSSMU@osc.ny.gov for delivery instructions. Dormancy only began running Nov 22 2022, when the law took effect.
Most property is 3 years. Notice Report due before Nov 1 for June 30 cut-off; remit report follows the next June. Due diligence 6 to 12 months before the Notice Report.
Digital financial assets added by S822 (2025), effective Jan 1 2026. Holder transfers the asset unliquidated to the Controller's custodian; Controller may sell 18 to 20 months after filing.
Report due July 1 for property held on March 1 (Prop. Code 74.101). Notice for property over $250, no later than 60 days before delivery (74.1011); the Comptroller's guide says mail by May 1.
SB 1244 (eff. Sept 1 2025) added 74.3014: deliver in native form if the holder fully controls the private keys. Uses the general 3-year period; confirm with the Comptroller.
General 5-year period (717.102). Report before May 1 for the prior calendar year (717.117). Notice 90 to 180 days before filing; certified mail at least 60 days before for over $1,000.
7 years (717.1065). Holder liquidates within 30 days before filing and remits proceeds (717.119(4)).
